subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and replay media from unmentioned requireMention group messages for later mentioned turns, and what bounded privacy/retention policy should govern it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes whether bystander group attachments can be retained and exposed to a later model prompt, and current main intentionally skips unmentioned non-audio media before download.

options.title: Approve Bounded Image Retention
options.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing authorization and context-visibility rules, without leaking local paths into prompt text.

options.title: Keep Unmentioned Media Text-Only
options.body: Treat unmentioned Telegram group media as intentionally unavailable to later turns and document that group history stores only placeholders for this case.

options.title: Require Live Design Proof First
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer-reviewed live Telegram proof demonstrates the current failure and proposed retention behavior with privacy limits.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Image Retention
recommendation.body: Record only bounded local image HistoryEntry.media for skipped Telegram group messages under existing authorization and context-visibility rules, without leaking local paths into prompt text.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest recent owner signal for Telegram group-history behavior and scoped policy decisions.
